title: Circular fund flow detected — potential layering
description: Funds originating from ACC-001 traversed through 4 intermediary accounts and returned within 72 hours. Pattern consistent with layering activity.

title: Rapid sequential transfers across jurisdictions
description: Three outbound transfers totaling $245,000 executed within 4 hours across different jurisdictions. Velocity exceeds baseline by 8x.

title: Suspected account takeover — new device + unusual transfer
description: Transfer of $58,000 initiated from an unrecognized device (new browser fingerprint) at 3:12 AM, outside the account holder's normal activity window.

title: Synthetic identity indicators on new account
description: Account ACC-007 opened 45 days ago shows pattern consistent with synthetic identity: rapid credit buildup, no prior history, and transfers to known high-risk corridor.

title: Transfer to high-risk beneficiary flagged by network intel
description: Outbound wire to ACC-008 which has been flagged in 3 prior investigations across partner institutions.

title: Unusually large transfer — 12x above account baseline
description: Single transfer of $340,000 from ACC-009, whose average transaction is $28,000. No prior high-value activity in 24-month history.

title: Potential structuring — multiple sub-threshold transfers
description: 12 transfers averaging $9,400 each over 48 hours from ACC-010 to 3 beneficiary accounts. Total $112,800, just below reporting threshold per transaction.

title: Rapid disbursement to multiple new beneficiaries
description: Funds quickly redistributed to 3 accounts opened within the last 30 days. Pattern consistent with mule network activity.

title: Off-hours international wire — potential unauthorized access
description: International wire of $22,500 initiated at 2:47 AM from a mobile device not previously seen. Account holder's usual activity is weekday business hours.

title: Behavioral deviation — new payment channel and recipient
description: First-time ACH transfer to an unseen recipient via newly linked external account. Amount within normal range but channel and recipient are novel.
